name: gdb_console
description: Run one unrestricted GDB CLI command through MI interpreter-exec console and return raw MI, console, target, and log records inline with Evidence. A command timeout preserves collected records with completion_status unknown and stops the owned debugger session. Commands can execute shell, alter target state, access files, and use network. Closing the debugger never implies target termination. In a shared MCP server, this admitted command closes any active binary-analysis session; after its effects have settled, call open_binary before further analysis. Close an active Ghidra session explicitly first.
